title: Rama refutes the atheistic arguments of Jabali
introduction: Rama refutes the atheistic arguments of Jabali and enunciates the importance of truthfulness. He states that truth is God and all virtues follow truthfulness. Rama further adds that there is nothing higher than truth. He announces that he wants to fulfil the command of is father, who was a devotee of truth and stay back in the forest. Jabali replies that just for the sake of convincing Rama to return to Ayodhya, he has spoken the words of a non-believer.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमाद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे नवोत्तरशततमः सर्गः
Thus completes 109th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
जाबालेः तु वचः श्रुत्वा रामः सत्य आत्मनाम् वरः |
उवाच परया युक्त्या स्व बुद्ध्या च अविपन्नया
verses.iast:
jābāleḥ tu vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ satya ātmanām varaḥ |
uvāca parayā yuktyā sva buddhyā ca avipannayā
verses.translation: After hearing Jabali's words, Rama the best among virtuous and upright men spoke with a great devotion and with an undisturbed mind of his own (as follows);

verses.devanagari:
भवान् मे प्रिय काम अर्थम् वचनम् यद् इह उक्तवान् |
अकार्यम् कार्य सम्काशम् अपथ्यम् पथ्य सम्मितम्
verses.iast:
bhavān me priya kāma artham vacanam yad iha uktavān |
akāryam kārya samkāśam apathyam pathya sammitam
verses.translation: "That which, in your desire to please me, you have counselled, is impossible though it appears to be possible. It is like a forbidden food, appearing to be an agreeable one."

glosses.meaning: It is like a forbidden food
appearing to be an agreeable one.

verses.devanagari:
निर्मर्यादः तु पुरुषः पाप आचार समन्वितः |
मानम् न लभते सत्सु भिन्न चारित्र दर्शनः
verses.iast:
nirmaryādaḥ tu puruṣaḥ pāpa ācāra samanvitaḥ |
mānam na labhate satsu bhinna cāritra darśanaḥ
verses.translation: "He who is unruly, fully invested with ill-conduct, having a bad reputation and seeing differences in everything, does not gain respect from honest men."

glosses.meaning: having a bad reputation and seeing differentiation in everything

verses.devanagari:
कुलीनम् अकुलीनम् वा वीरम् पुरुष मानिनम् |
चारित्रम् एव व्याख्याति शुचिम् वा यदि वा अशुचिम्
verses.iast:
kulīnam akulīnam vā vīram puruṣa māninam |
cāritram eva vyākhyāti śucim vā yadi vā aśucim
verses.translation: "One's conduct itself explains whether one belongs to a good family or a bad family, valiant or arrogant and chaste or unchaste."

glosses.meaning: whether one belongs to a good family

verses.devanagari:
अनारयः तु आर्य सम्काशः शौचाद्द् हीनः तथा शुचिः |
लक्षण्यवद् अलक्षण्यो दुह्शीलः शीलवान् इव
अधर्मम् धर्म वेषेण यदि इमम् लोक सम्करम् |
अभिपत्स्ये शुभम् हित्वा क्रिया विधि विवर्जितम्
कः चेतयानः पुरुषः कार्य अकार्य विचक्षणः |
बहु मंस्यति माम् लोके दुर्वृत्तम् लोक दूषणम्
verses.iast:
anārayḥ tu ārya samkāśaḥ śaucādd hīnaḥ tathā śuciḥ |
lakṣaṇyavad alakṣaṇyo duhśīlaḥ śīlavān iva
adharmam dharma veṣeṇa yadi imam loka samkaram |
abhipatsye śubham hitvā kriyā vidhi vivarjitam
kaḥ cetayānaḥ puruṣaḥ kārya akārya vicakṣaṇaḥ |
bahu maṃsyati mām loke durvṛttam loka dūṣaṇam
verses.translation: "What sensible man, able to discern what is just and what is unjust, in this world, would respect me, if I am ignoble resembling as noble, bereft of honesty, impure, having no good qualities but appearing like the one having good qualities, ill-behaved but appearing as well-behaved abandoning righteousness and getting hold of unrighteousness in the guise of piety, creating confusion in the world and disregarding rules of conduct."

glosses.meaning: able to discern what is just and what is unjust
though appearing like one having good qualities

verses.devanagari:
कस्य यास्याम्य् अहम् वृत्तम् केन वा स्वर्गम् आप्नुयाम् |
अनया वर्तमानो अहम् वृत्त्या हीन प्रतिज्नया
verses.iast:
kasya yāsyāmy aham vṛttam kena vā svargam āpnuyām |
anayā vartamāno aham vṛttyā hīna pratijnayā
verses.translation: "If I behave in this manner faithlessly, to whom can I advise a prescribed conduct? How would I attain heaven?"

verses.devanagari:
काम वृत्तः तु अयम् लोकः कृत्स्नः समुपवर्तते |
यद् वृत्ताः सन्ति राजानः तद् वृत्ताः सन्ति हि प्रजाः
verses.iast:
kāma vṛttaḥ tu ayam lokaḥ kṛtsnaḥ samupavartate |
yad vṛttāḥ santi rājānaḥ tad vṛttāḥ santi hi prajāḥ
verses.translation: "This entire world would follow its own whims, for, whatever the conduct of the kings may be, such will be the coduct of their subjects."

glosses.meaning: may be santi tadvR^ittaaH = such will be the conduct

verses.devanagari:
सत्यम् एव आनृशंस्यम् च राज वृत्तम् सनातनम् |
तस्मात् सत्य आत्मकम् राज्यम् सत्ये लोकः प्रतिष्ठितः
verses.iast:
satyam eva ānṛśaṃsyam ca rāja vṛttam sanātanam |
tasmāt satya ātmakam rājyam satye lokaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: "The eternal royal governance is indeed an assemble of truth and not cruel. Hence, the kingship has the Truth as its essence. The world is established in Truth."

glosses.meaning: is indeed an assemble of truth
has the truth as its essence

verses.devanagari:
ऋषयः चैव देवाः च सत्यम् एव हि मेनिरे |
सत्य वादी हि लोके अस्मिन् परमम् गग्च्छति क्षयम्
verses.iast:
ṛṣayaḥ caiva devāḥ ca satyam eva hi menire |
satya vādī hi loke asmin paramam gagcchati kṣayam
verses.translation: "Even sages and divine being have respected truthfulness alone. The one who speaks truth obtains the highest position in this world."

verses.devanagari:
उद्विजन्ते यथा सर्पान् नराद् अनृत वादिनः |
धर्मः सत्यम् परो लोके मूलम् स्वर्गस्य च उच्यते
verses.iast:
udvijante yathā sarpān narād anṛta vādinaḥ |
dharmaḥ satyam paro loke mūlam svargasya ca ucyate
verses.translation: "People fear of a person, who speaks untruth, as one fears a snake. Truth is the highest virtue and is stated to be the origin of heaven."

verses.devanagari:
सत्यम् एव ईश्वरो लोके सत्यम् पद्मा समाश्रिता |
सत्य मूलानि सर्वाणि सत्यान् न अस्ति परम् पदम्
verses.iast:
satyam eva īśvaro loke satyam padmā samāśritā |
satya mūlāni sarvāṇi satyān na asti param padam
verses.translation: "Truth is god and all virtues follow truth. All are rooted in truth there is nothing higher than truth."

glosses.meaning: i god loke = in this world

verses.devanagari:
दत्तम् इष्टम् हुतम् चैव तप्तानि च तपांसि च |
वेदाः सत्य प्रतिष्ठानाः तस्मात् सत्य परो भवेत्
verses.iast:
dattam iṣṭam hutam caiva taptāni ca tapāṃsi ca |
vedāḥ satya pratiṣṭhānāḥ tasmāt satya paro bhavet
verses.translation: "Gift sacrifice, oblation, austerities performed and the scriptural texts have the foundation in Truth. Hence, one should thoroughly surrender to truth.

verses.devanagari:
एकः पालयते लोकम् एकः पालयते कुलम् |
मज्जत्य् एको हि निरयः एकः स्वर्गे महीयते
verses.iast:
ekaḥ pālayate lokam ekaḥ pālayate kulam |
majjaty eko hi nirayaḥ ekaḥ svarge mahīyate
verses.translation: "One rules over the world. One develops a race. One sinks into hell . One rises high to heaven (according to one's degree of truthfulness practiced)."

verses.devanagari:
सो अहम् पितुर् निदेशम् तु किम् अर्थम् न अनुपालये |
सत्य प्रतिश्रवः सत्यम् सत्येन समयी कृतः
verses.iast:
so aham pitur nideśam tu kim artham na anupālaye |
satya pratiśravaḥ satyam satyena samayī kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "I am true to my promise. Why should I not fulfilll the command of my father, who was a devotee of truth?"

glosses.meaning: which was a devotee satyam = of truth.

verses.devanagari:
न एव लोभान् न मोहाद् वा न च अज्नानात् तमो अन्वितः |
सेतुम् सत्यस्य भेत्स्यामि गुरोः सत्य प्रतिश्रवः
verses.iast:
na eva lobhān na mohād vā na ca ajnānāt tamo anvitaḥ |
setum satyasya bhetsyāmi guroḥ satya pratiśravaḥ
verses.translation: "Neither covetousness nor forgetfulness nor pride would cause me to destroy the bond of morality. I shall honour the vow made to my father."

verses.devanagari:
असत्य संधस्य सतः चलस्य अस्थिर चेतसः |
न एव देवा न पितरः प्रतीग्च्छन्ति इति नः श्रुतम्
verses.iast:
asatya saṃdhasya sataḥ calasya asthira cetasaḥ |
na eva devā na pitaraḥ pratīgcchanti iti naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: "Neither gods nor the manes will accept the offerings of those who are wanting in truth, unsteady and unstable in their minds. This is what is taught to us."

glosses.meaning: of those who are wanting in truth

verses.devanagari:
प्रत्यग् आत्मम् इमम् धर्मम् सत्यम् पश्याम्य् अहम् स्वयम् |
भारः सत् पुरुष आचीर्णः तद् अर्थम् अभिनन्द्यते
verses.iast:
pratyag ātmam imam dharmam satyam paśyāmy aham svayam |
bhāraḥ sat puruṣa ācīrṇaḥ tad artham abhinandyate
verses.translation: "I perceive this virtue i the form of truthfulness as a universal permeation of spirit. That is why, this burden, observed as a vow, has been honoured by good men."

glosses.meaning: virtue in the form of truthfulness
as a universal permeation of spirit

verses.devanagari:
क्षात्रम् धर्मम् अहम् त्यक्ष्ये ह्य् अधर्मम् धर्म सम्हितम् |
क्षुद्रौर् नृशंसैर् लुब्धैः च सेवितम् पाप कर्मभिः
verses.iast:
kṣātram dharmam aham tyakṣye hy adharmam dharma samhitam |
kṣudraur nṛśaṃsair lubdhaiḥ ca sevitam pāpa karmabhiḥ
verses.translation: "I renounce the so-called duty of a warrior, it is injustice under the name of justice, it is practised by petty cruel and covetous men of evil deeds."

glosses.meaning: the so-called duty of a warrior

verses.devanagari:
कायेन कुरुते पापम् मनसा सम्प्रधार्य च |
अनृतम् जिह्वया च आह त्रिविधम् कर्म पातकम्
verses.iast:
kāyena kurute pāpam manasā sampradhārya ca |
anṛtam jihvayā ca āha trividham karma pātakam
verses.translation: "Sin is committed by the body after it has been conceived by the mind and falsehood is spoken with the tongue. Thus, the degrading act is of three types (with body, mind and tongue)"

verses.devanagari:
भूमिः कीर्तिर् यशो लक्ष्मीः पुरुषम् प्रार्थयन्ति हि |
स्वर्गस्थम् च अनुबध्नन्ति सत्यम् एव भजेत तत्
verses.iast:
bhūmiḥ kīrtir yaśo lakṣmīḥ puruṣam prārthayanti hi |
svargastham ca anubadhnanti satyam eva bhajeta tat
verses.translation: "The earth, fame, prosperity and fortune indeed woo a man of truth. They constantly oblige the truth: truth should therefore be strictly observed!"

verses.devanagari:
श्रेष्ठम् ह्य् अनार्यम् एव स्याद् यद् भवान् अवधार्य माम् |
आह युक्ति करैर् वाक्यैर् इदम् भद्रम् कुरुष्व ह
verses.iast:
śreṣṭham hy anāryam eva syād yad bhavān avadhārya mām |
āha yukti karair vākyair idam bhadram kuruṣva ha
verses.translation: "The logical words, you have made it out to be good, saying 'Do this good thing' as uttered to me, are really unworthy."

verses.devanagari:
कथम् ह्य् अहम् प्रतिज्नाय वन वासम् इमम् गुरोः |
भरतस्य करिष्यामि वचो हित्वा गुरोर् वचः
verses.iast:
katham hy aham pratijnāya vana vāsam imam guroḥ |
bharatasya kariṣyāmi vaco hitvā guror vacaḥ
verses.translation: "Having promised before my father about my exile to the forest, how can I fulfil Bharata's words now, abandoning the father's words?"

glosses.meaning: about my exile to the forest

verses.devanagari:
स्थिरा मया प्रतिज्नाता प्रतिज्ना गुरु सम्निधौ |
प्रहृष्ट मानसा देवी कैकेयी च अभवत् तदा
verses.iast:
sthirā mayā pratijnātā pratijnā guru samnidhau |
prahṛṣṭa mānasā devī kaikeyī ca abhavat tadā
verses.translation: "A firm promise has been made by me in the presence of my father, when Queen Kaikeyi too became rejoiced."

glosses.meaning: in the presence of my father

verses.devanagari:
वन वासम् वसन्न् एवम् शुचिर् नियत भोजनः |
मूलैः पुष्पैः फलैः पुण्यैः पितृऋन् देवामः च तर्पयन्
सम्तुष्ट पन्च वर्गो अहम् लोक यात्राम् प्रवर्तये |
अकुहः श्रद्दधानः सन् कार्य अकार्य विचक्षणः
verses.iast:
vana vāsam vasann evam śucir niyata bhojanaḥ |
mūlaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ puṇyaiḥ pitṛṛn devāmḥ ca tarpayan
samtuṣṭa panca vargo aham loka yātrām pravartaye |
akuhaḥ śraddadhānaḥ san kārya akārya vicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "I will proceed with life-journey in this manner, by accepting this dwelling in the forest, by remaining pure in body and mind, having controlled my diet, by feasting the Gods and Ancestors with pure roots, flowers and fruits, with all my five senses fully sated, without any deceit, fully devout and discriminative of what ought to be done and what ought not to be done."

glosses.meaning: by remaining pure of body and mind
with all my five senses fully sated
discriminative of what ought to be done and what ought not to be done.

verses.devanagari:
कर्म भूमिम् इमाम् प्राप्य कर्तव्यम् कर्म यत् शुभम् |
अग्निर् वायुः च सोमः च कर्मणाम् फल भागिनः
verses.iast:
karma bhūmim imām prāpya kartavyam karma yat śubham |
agnir vāyuḥ ca somaḥ ca karmaṇām phala bhāginaḥ
verses.translation: "Having reached this terrestrial globe (the realm of action), only a virtuous act is to be undertaken. The god of fire, the wind-god and the moon-god reap the fruits of their acts."

verses.devanagari:
शतम् क्रतूनाम् आहृत्य देव राट् त्रिदिवम् गतः |
तपांस्य् उग्राणि च आस्थाय दिवम् याता महर्षयः
verses.iast:
śatam kratūnām āhṛtya deva rāṭ tridivam gataḥ |
tapāṃsy ugrāṇi ca āsthāya divam yātā maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: "Having performed ahundred sacrifices, Indra the Lord of celestials went to heaven. Having practised severe austerities, the great sages went to heaven."

verses.devanagari:
अमृष्यमाणः पुनरुग्रतेजा |
निशम्य तं नास्तिकवाक्यहेतुम् |
अथाब्रवीत्तं नृपतेस्तनूजो |
विगर्हमाणो वचानानि तस्य
verses.iast:
amṛṣyamāṇaḥ punarugratejā |
niśamya taṃ nāstikavākyahetum |
athābravīttaṃ nṛpatestanūjo |
vigarhamāṇo vacānāni tasya
verses.translation: Hearing that argument of atheism inuntiated by Jabali, Rama the prince with a terrible energy, without tolerating his words, spoke in reproach to him (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
सत्यं च धर्मं च पराक्रमं च |
भूतानुकम्पां प्रियवादिताम् च |
द्विजातिदेवातिथिपूजनं च |
पन्थानमाहुस्त्रिदिवस्य सन्तः
verses.iast:
satyaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca parākramaṃ ca |
bhūtānukampāṃ priyavāditām ca |
dvijātidevātithipūjanaṃ ca |
panthānamāhustridivasya santaḥ
verses.translation: "The virtuous say that truth, piety, valour, compassion for all beings, polite speech and worship of Brahmanas, gods and unexpected guests are the paths to heaven."

verses.devanagari:
तेनैवमाज्ञाय यथावदर्थ |
मेकोदयं सम्प्रतिपद्य विप्राः |
धर्मं चरन्तः सकलं यथाव |
त्काज़्^ख़्षन्ति लोकागममप्रमत्ताः
verses.iast:
tenaivamājJṇāya yathāvadartha |
mekodayaṃ sampratipadya viprāḥ |
dharmaṃ carantaḥ sakalaṃ yathāva |
tkāJ^Kṣanti lokāgamamapramattāḥ
verses.translation: "Therefore the learned, well-instructed in what is to be their greatest advantage; follow their purpose resolutely and fulfill their duty in its entirety properly and attentively, seeking to attain the highest realms."

verses.devanagari:
निन्दाम्यहं कर्म पितुः कृतं त |
द्यस्त्वामगृह्णाद्विषमस्थबुद्धिम् |
बुद्ध्यानयैवंविधया चरन्तं |
सुनास्तिकं धर्मपथादपेतम्
verses.iast:
nindāmyahaṃ karma pituḥ kṛtaṃ ta |
dyastvāmagṛhṇādviṣamasthabuddhim |
buddhyānayaivaṃvidhayā carantaṃ |
sunāstikaṃ dharmapathādapetam
verses.translation: "I accuse the act done by my father in taking you into his service, you with your misleading intelligence, a firm atheist fallen from the true path."

glosses.meaning: in taking you into his service

verses.devanagari:
यथा हि चोरः स तथा हि बुद्ध |
स्तथागतं नास्तिकमत्र विध्हि |
तस्माद्धि यः शङ्क्यतमः प्रजानाम् |
न नास्ति केनाभिमुखो बुधः स्यात्
verses.iast:
yathā hi coraḥ sa tathā hi buddha |
stathāgataṃ nāstikamatra vidhhi |
tasmāddhi yaḥ śaṇ^kyatamaḥ prajānām |
na nāsti kenābhimukho budhaḥ syāt
verses.translation: "It is an exact state of the case that a mere *intellection deserves to be punished as it were a thief and know an atheist to be on par with a mere intellectual. Therefore he is the most suspectable and should be punished in the interest of the poeple. In no case should a wise man consort with an atheist."
notes: * It is the word that is responding to the chanllenge, which we call intellection. Truth/God is very subtle. A mind that is caught in the net of words/arguments cannot understand truth/God.

glosses.meaning: It is an exact state of the case
(is deserves to be punished) as a thief
to be on par with a mere intellectual
(should be punished in the interest of) the people

verses.devanagari:
त्वत्तो जनाः पूर्वतरे वराश्च |
शुभानि कर्माणि बहूनि चक्रुः |
चित्वा सदेमं च परम् च लौकं |
तस्माद्द्विजाः स्वस्ति हुतं कृतं च
verses.iast:
tvatto janāḥ pūrvatare varāśca |
śubhāni karmāṇi bahūni cakruḥ |
citvā sademaṃ ca param ca laukaṃ |
tasmāddvijāḥ svasti hutaṃ kṛtaṃ ca
verses.translation: "Men that lived before you have performed many auspicious acts, abandoning all hopes of reward in this world as well as the next. Therefore, Brahmanas offer oblations in the sacred fire and practise noble deeds."

glosses.meaning: offer oblations in the sacred five

verses.devanagari:
धर्मे रताः सत् पुरुषैः समेताः |
तेजस्विनो दान गुण प्रधानाः |
अहिंसका वीत मलाः च लोके |
भवन्ति पूज्या मुनयः प्रधानाः
verses.iast:
dharme ratāḥ sat puruṣaiḥ sametāḥ |
tejasvino dāna guṇa pradhānāḥ |
ahiṃsakā vīta malāḥ ca loke |
bhavanti pūjyā munayaḥ pradhānāḥ
verses.translation: "The sages who are devoted to righteousness, associating with men of virtue, endowed with spiritual splendour, practising abundant charity, harm-less and washed free of all taint, are honoured into the world."

verses.devanagari:
इति ब्रुवन्तं वचनं सरोषं |
रामं महात्मानमदीनसत्त्वम् |
उवाच पथ्यं पुनरास्तिकं च |
सत्यं वचः सानुनयं च विप्रः
verses.iast:
iti bruvantaṃ vacanaṃ saroṣaṃ |
rāmaṃ mahātmānamadīnasattvam |
uvāca pathyaṃ punarāstikaṃ ca |
satyaṃ vacaḥ sānunayaṃ ca vipraḥ
verses.translation: "To the high-souled Rama, who never had self-pity and speaking indignantly as aforesaid, Jabali (that brahmana) replied in a fitting manner in words that were beneficial and truthful, which showed his belief in authority of Vedas, the other world and so on."

glosses.meaning: which showed his belief in authority of Vedas

verses.devanagari:
न नास्तिकानां वचनम् ब्रवीम्यहं |
न नास्तिकोऽहं न च नास्ति किंचन |
समीक्ष्य कालं पुनरास्तिकोऽभवं |
भवेय काले पुनरेव नास्तिकः
verses.iast:
na nāstikānāṃ vacanam bravīmyahaṃ |
na nāstiko'haṃ na ca nāsti kiñcana |
samīkṣya kālaṃ punarāstiko'bhavaṃ |
bhaveya kāle punareva nāstikaḥ
verses.translation: "I am not speaking the words of non- believers. I am not an atheist, nor is it a fact that nothing exists whatsoever. Perceiving the time, I have become a believer. When the time comes, I will become again just a non-believer."

glosses.meaning: now is it a fact that nothing exists

verses.devanagari:
स चापि कालोऽय मुपागतः शनैः |
यथा मया नास्तिकवागुदीरिता |
निवर्तनार्थं तव राम कारणात् |
प्रसादनार्थं च मयैतदीरितम् ||
verses.iast:
sa cāpi kālo'ya mupāgataḥ śanaiḥ |
yathā mayā nāstikavāgudīritā |
nivartanārthaṃ tava rāma kāraṇāt |
prasādanārthaṃ ca mayaitadīritam ||
verses.translation: "O, Rama! That and this time too came gradually. The words of a non-believer were spoken by me for your sake, to pacify you and to persuade you to return to Ayodhya."

glosses.meaning: and to persuade you to return (to Ayodhya).
